title: Expose both HOBEIAN ZG-305Z USB outputs as switches
problem: The dual-output USB power controller advertises both independently switched endpoints as On/Off Lights, so ZHA exposes USB power controls as light entities.
reproduce: Pair a HOBEIAN ZG-305Z whose endpoint descriptors report device type 0x0100 on endpoints 1 and 2; both controls are classified as lights.
acceptance: Endpoints 1 and 2 retain their clusters but use the ZHA On/Off Output device type, and focused tests prove both are discovered as switch-class endpoints.
repair: Register a declarative model-specific quirk that replaces both endpoint device types with ON_OFF_OUTPUT and add a focused two-endpoint regression.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies the exact declarative endpoint replacements and regression coverage. Upstream tests passed separately. A physical ZG-305Z is still required to confirm that endpoint 1 maps to one USB connector and endpoint 2 to the other.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the draft on the reported ZHA setup, re-pair or reload the device, and confirm two switch entities appear. Toggle each one and record whether it independently controls the USB-C or USB-A output.

selection.reason: A one-day-old hardware report provides the exact two-endpoint signature, expected entity type and a reporter with the physical device available for immediate validation.
